dedupe_keys.name: tafssa district agrifood systems assessment bangladesh 2023 retail shop survey in rangpur and rajshahi

description: This survey describes the shops that sell food in rural villages of two districts of northern Bangladesh. It was carried out by the International Rice Research Institute and the International Food Policy Research Institute for Transforming Agrifood Systems in South Asia (TAFSSA), a CGIAR initiative, and published on Harvard Dataverse in 2024. Data were collected between February and June 2023 in 50 villages in each of Rangpur and Rajshahi districts, covering formal and informal retail shops, from local grocery stores to specialised sellers of meat, fish, eggs or dairy. Structured questionnaires had three modules: an interview on the vendor, assortment and availability of essential goods, resilience, food sourcing, food wastage and access; an observation and photo module on market information, infrastructure, quality, safety and hygiene; and further modules described in the documentation. The data come as many tab-separated tables, free to download online under custom Dataverse terms. Caveats: the sample is two districts of one country, and some modules need the questionnaires to interpret. Simulation uses: rural food retail network, sourcing and stock resilience inputs for food supply disruption models in South Asia. Related records: the New York State retail food stores (data-nys-retail-food-stores) and the Food Environment Atlas (data-food-environment-atlas-p02896) are examples of retail food environment data elsewhere.
